title: GPU Admission Tracker — Q1 2026
content:
Purpose:
This sheet is the living intake & triage board for ad-hoc and planned GPU capacity requests across regions. Use this when teams need additional accelerators for experiments, spikes, or production ramps. It is lightweight: fill one row per request and add updates in the Notes column.

How to use:
- Fill required fields (request id, owner, team, workload, requested GPUs, preferred region, earliest start, deadline, priority, justification).
- Attach Jira ticket in Linked Artifact column.
- Capacity team will triage within 3 business days and set Temporary Allocation or Deny.
- For long-running production needs (>90 days) a Dedicated Capacity request template must be started (link above).

Current capacity snapshot (2026-03-09):
- Global physical GPUs: 1200 (NVIDIA H100-equivalent)
- Reserved for Dedicated contracts: 420 GPUs
- On-demand pool (hosted + private burst): 480 GPUs
- Buffer / emergency reserve: 150 GPUs
- Estimated available for new requests: 210 GPUs (after planned maintenance window week 13)
- Region breakout (available approx): us-west: 90, us-east: 60, eu-west: 40, ap-south: 20

Triage rules (abbreviated):
- Priority: Blocker > High > Medium > Low. Blocker = customer-facing outage or experiment gating launch.
- Short-term allocation: up to 16 GPUs for <=14 days can be approved by infra on triage. Larger or longer requests need Eng Manager + Infra Director approval.
- If region lacks capacity, propose cross-region fallback in Notes.
- Quantization/spot suggestions: infra will propose quantized variants or spot-backed pools if cost/availability helps.

Columns (sheet):
Request ID | Owner | Team | Workload / PRD | Requested GPUs | Preferred region(s) | Earliest start | Deadline | Priority | Justification (short) | Duration estimate | Linked artifact (Jira/PR) | Approval status | Approver | Notes / Dependencies | Estimated monthly GPU-hours | Kernel/hardware preferences

Sample rows:
RQ-2026-011 | Maria Gomez | research-rl | RL environ scaling for multi-agent sim | 8 | us-west | 2026-03-20 | 2026-04-03 | High | Need to finish hyperparam sweep blocking milestone M5 | 14 days | https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RL-314 | Approved (temp) | Liam Chen | Requires dataset mount; will use spot where possible; follow-up on perf on 3/22 | 8,640 | H100
RQ-2026-022 | API Team (owner: Noah Park) | product-hosted-api | Load-test for new batching path | 32 | us-east, fallback eu-west | 2026-03-25 | 2026-03-29 | Blocker | Must validate latency at peak qps before canary rollout | 5 days | https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/API-789 | Pending | - | Team to provide synthetic load; may require burst pool escalation; request flagged for expedited review | 11,520 | H100/8-bit friendly
RQ-2026-035 | Data Platform (owner: Priya Singh) | eng-platform | Embedding reindex (monthly job) | 16 | eu-west | 2026-04-05 | 2026-04-12 | Medium | Regular monthly job; flexible within week | 7 days | https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DP-421 | Approved (scheduled) | Ravi Kapoor | Can shift to ap-south if eu-west tight; plan to use mixed-precision to reduce hours | 5,376 | A100 compatible
RQ-2026-047 | Solutions Eng (owner: Tom Rivers) | solutions-engineering-and-professional-services | Customer PoC (sensitive data, VPC) | 4 | us-west (private) | 2026-03-18 | 2026-04-15 | High | Customer requires private GPU for pilot | 28 days | https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-233 | Pending (security review) | Katherine O'Neill | Needs KMS key provisioning; security to approve network configs | 2,304 | Private-hosted H100
RQ-2026-051 | Applied ML (owner: Elena Ivanova) | applied-ml | LLM quantization sweep for latency targets | 24 | us-west | 2026-04-01 | 2026-04-30 | Low | Research objective — not blocking product but useful | 30 days | https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AML-577 | Denied (optimize) | Liam Chen | Suggested infra offers quantized test pool with fewer GPUs; propose slice of spot-backed nodes | 17,280 | Quantization-friendly

Outstanding action items (triage meeting 2026-03-10):
- Noah / API team to provide clearer load profile (p95, p99, seq length). Deadline 2026-03-12.
- Solutions Eng to open security intake ticket for VPC access (owner: Katherine).
- Infra to publish week-by-week reserve forecast for weeks 12-16 (owner: Aisha).

Notes & heuristics / backlog guidance:
- Prefer smaller allocations + more frequent retries over huge single allocations when possible — this reduces cold-start and eviction blast radius.
- Encourage teams to propose quantized or cached variants; infra will add suggested configs in Notes when triaging.
- If a request is >48 GPUs and >30 days, escalate automatically to Capacity Planning sync and sales/finance for potential Dedicated commit.

Revision history (short):

- 2026-02-05: added triage SLA and region breakout.
- 2026-03-09: updated capacity snapshot post-maintenance planning and added sample rows from recent intake.
